name: Yuuzutsu Hanene
source:
Young daughter from Yuuzutsu, decided to enroll at Saint Solyluna Academy and became a student at "Moon Academy".

[spoiler]She wanted to become this year's μ and had her wish of saving Ayame granted.[/spoiler]
